head: working-tree
subject: Cluster lrs_server ConfigSource.self
change: CDS Cluster.lrs_server (field 42) is now decoded. Only ConfigSource.self is accepted, matching grpc-core; the cluster then reports through the controller's LRS control plane. Other LRS servers and malformed ConfigSource values fail closed. transport_socket_matches remains rejected.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/cds/tests.zig 'gRPC CDS accepts lrs_server self and rejects other servers' covers self acceptance, ConfigSource.ads rejection and malformed ConfigSource rejection.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='gRPC CDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC LDS' -Dtest-filter='SDS' -Dtest-filter='LRS' -Dtest-filter='xDS TLS' -Dtest-filter='lrs_server' --summary all

full_library.notes: This is the same test binary produced by zig build test-lib. It was run from a tmpfs working directory because the shared NVMe drive was 92% utilized by sibling projects and journal-writing bridge tests blocked for minutes on ext4 writeback, which made zig-build-driven full runs hang. With tmpfs temp files the suite printed per-test progress and passed all 6510 tests.

notes: Per-cluster LRS servers other than self remain unsupported. Cluster reporting still uses the single LRS control plane configured in runtime.Options.lrs.
